explanation: The statement is about Mathlib's own definition `Units.ofPowEqOne` (defined at line 111 of the same file) and its proof is just `Units.ext` plus `simp [ha]`, i.e. the fact that the underlying value of `Units.ofPowEqOne a n ha hn` is `a`. No other Mathlib declaration states this: greps for `ofPowEqOne`, `ofPow`, `Units.pow_eq_one`, `coe/val_pow_eq_one`, `of_pow_eq_one` across Mathlib (and Batteries/Lean core) only turn up the definition, this lemma, and uses of it (`RootsOfUnity.Basic`, `Invertible.Basic`, `KummerExtension`); the additive companion is the `to_additive` image of the same declaration. The nearest general results (`Units.ext_iff`, `Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val`, `RootsOfUnity.mem_rootsOfUnity'`) are only structural/definitional glue (the latter also needs a `CommMonoid`, whereas the theorem is for an arbitrary `Monoid`), so there is no single Mathlib declaration whose content this is.
